meta.title: Flagged for Review — items that could NOT be confirmed from an official verified source
meta.policy: Per project rules, any value that cannot be confirmed from an official source is left BLANK in the data tables and listed here with the reason. Nothing is inferred or filled in. These items do not block publication; they are published on the ‘Flagged for Review’ page for manual review.
meta.note: Rows above FL-16 are the 2026-11-18 dated official re-read and the register-level conflicts it found; they were renumbered from FL-16..FL-23 to FL-17..FL-24 on that date so both sessions' rows survive the merge (the earlier FL-16, Game Book reuse permission, came from the injury-capture session).

rows.item: Numeric Pearson correlation coefficients between specific bet legs / prop pairs (e.g., QB passing yards vs team moneyline)
rows.reason: No official source publishes pairwise correlation values for betting markets; sportsbooks keep SGP/correlation pricing models proprietary. Values will be computed from our own logged bet data via the NIST formula before any combo strategy goes live (gate G7).

rows.item: Numeric home-field-advantage point value used in our own spread model (commonly cited as ~2.5–3 points in non-official commentary)
rows.reason: No NFL/official source publishes a single HFA constant; the value must be estimated from our own historical data and validated through gates G2–G5 before use. Not filled in.

rows.item: Historical backtest performance (win rate, ROI, CLV) of strategies ST-01…ST-09
rows.reason: No performance numbers are published because none have been computed yet from official data through the validation gates; any number here would be a hallucination. Cells intentionally blank.

rows.item: Exact vig/overround percentage for each specific market at each specific sportsbook
rows.reason: Prices move continuously and books do not publish their margin per market (Pinnacle: ‘few, if any, bookmakers publicly share it’). Only the standard -110 = 52.38% implied per side (11-to-10) is verified; per-market vig must be computed at bet time from posted odds via the official implied-probability formulas.

rows.item: ‘Sharpest book’ / specific CLV benchmark percentages quoted by non-official blogs (e.g., ‘+2% CLV is excellent’)
rows.reason: Such thresholds appear only on third-party sites, not on official sources; our leaderboard uses mean CLV > 0 plus statistical testing rather than a magic number.

rows.item: Live odds/lines, current standings, current injury report values as permanent data
rows.reason: These are dynamic official pages (verified live on 2026-11-01); snapshots are recorded with as-of timestamps in league_facts.json, but the live pages remain the source of truth. Values are re-pulled, never hard-coded.

rows.item: Which U.S. states currently license online sportsbooks / where each user may legally bet
rows.reason: Licensing varies by state and changes; Nevada Regulation 22 is cited as the regulatory model for grading/house rules, but a 50-state legality list is not maintained here — users must check their own state regulator. Not filled in to avoid stale/incorrect claims.

rows.item: NFL Next Gen Stats raw tracking data access for the public
rows.reason: NFL publishes aggregated NGS metrics/charts publicly; raw per-play tracking is released only to clubs and via Big Data Bowl competitions (per NFL Football Operations). Raw-data API access terms are not published on an official public page — flagged rather than assumed.

rows.item: operations.nfl.com legacy URL /the-game/technology/nfl-next-gen-stats
rows.reason: That legacy path returned 404 on 2026-11-01; the current official NGS technology page is /gameday/technology/nfl-next-gen-stats, which is the URL cited in sources.json. Noted here as a reviewed irregularity (dead official link), not used as a source.

rows.item: National Problem Gambling Helpline phone number presentation
rows.reason: NCPG's official page (checked 2026-11-01) presents the helpline as 1-800-MY-RESET, while other official state pages (e.g., mn.gov) still list 1-800-GAMBLER (1-800-426-2537). Both route to the same NCPG helpline; we cite the NCPG page as primary and note the legacy number rather than guessing which display is current.

rows.item: Cited DraftKings Massachusetts house-rules edition (8.1.24 PDF) is archived as OBSOLETE by the regulator
rows.reason: The settlement rules quoted on this project were read from the 8.1.24 edition. The Massachusetts Gaming Commission's obsolete-rules archive (checked 2026-11-02) lists 8.1.24 as 'Obsolete as of 8.18.15'; the active edition is the one approved 10.7.26. The old link still resolves and the cited push/parlay/teaser rules are standard, but the citation is edition-stale and should be re-pointed at the active edition. Flagged, not silently swapped, because the 10.7.26 PDF itself could not be fetched by the review sandbox on 2026-11-02.

rows.item: Historical point-in-time injury and exact depth-order snapshots for offensive/defensive lineups
rows.reason: NFL.com publishes a live weekly injury report and official team roster listings. This repository does not contain pregame point-in-time injury/active-inactive snapshots, and the inspected NFL roster page does not give depth-chart order. No starter, backup, 2nd-, 3rd- or 4th-string replacement label or injury adjustment is inferred. Capture timestamped primary-source records and verify a source for exact depth order before using this signal.

rows.item: Official-source confirmation of the full historical game-line and player-stat archive used by the analysis
rows.reason: The committed historical inputs are downloaded from nflverse, a community-maintained repository, not directly from an NFL-operated publishing endpoint. The NFL's Genius Sports announcement identifies the official data distributor, but does not certify this nflverse snapshot or its completeness. NFL.com reconciliations are recorded for specific seasons/fields only; do not describe every derived historical row or price as independently confirmed by the NFL. Exact NFL-primary-source coverage beyond the listed reconciliations remains unverified.

rows.item: Current 2026 model/prop slate outputs are older than the live NFL schedule
rows.reason: The committed data manifest reports data_as_of_gameday 2026-11-01. On 2026-11-12 the official NFL Week 10 schedule page showed the Nov 12 Commanders–Giants game and Nov 15 games. The repository has not refreshed its model/prop outputs to that schedule in this branch. Treat any Week 9/next-slate projections as stale historical research, not current lines or picks; refresh the data and rerun all checks before presenting a live slate.

rows.item: NFL-wide depth-chart ordering (1st/2nd/3rd/4th string) from an official source
rows.reason: Re-verified 2026-11-13 against the official NFL.com weekly injury report (Week 10, all 8 chunks, all 32 teams) and the 2026 division standings (both chunks). The injury report carries Position, Injuries, Practice Status and Game Status only -- no depth rank. The inspected NFL.com roster page lists players without depth order. The NFL.com team depth-chart URL (e.g. /teams/new-england-patriots/depth-chart) returns HTTP 404. The one confirmed team-published chart (Indianapolis Colts) calls itself unofficial and covers one team only. No starter, backup, 2nd-, 3rd- or 4th-string replacement label is available from any official source; all such values remain blank.

rows.item: Official NFL Game Book route and reuse permission for row-level data
rows.reason: The generic NFL Operations Game Book URL returned an NFL 404 on 2026-11-18. One official NFL.com game centre links a game-specific Game Book PDF. The PDF states that use beyond assisting media coverage is prohibited without written NFL permission. The checked route proves only one game's availability and does not grant this project a right to copy, retain or republish raw rows. Keep raw Game Book capture blocked until source-specific terms or written permission is resolved.

rows.item: Week 11 official injury report (2026 season)
rows.reason: Not published at the 2026-11-18T03:55Z read: the /2026/reg11 URL served the Week 10 report while the week selector listed WEEK 11. Left blank rather than assumed to be unchanged from Week 10. Discovery action: re-read after the Wednesday 4:30 PM ET deadline and record the fetch time. (Row id FL-16 was taken by the Game Book permission flag from the injury-capture session, so the 2026-11-18 re-read rows start at FL-17.) RESOLVED at the 2026-11-19 integration re-read: /2026/REG11 now serves the Week 11 report (title and body both read WEEK 11; first block IND @ HOU, Thu Nov 19, 8:15 PM EST). No Week 11 register has been transcribed yet, so no Week 11 injury rows are published anywhere in the repository and the site's Week 11 availability columns stay blank by policy; a full transcription plus hash is a separate claimed task. The REG10 half of the title/body mismatch (its <title> reads 'Week 11' while the body reads WEEK 10) remains.

rows.item: Points for and points against, NFC South and NFC West clubs (8 rows)
rows.reason: The standings chunk carrying those two divisions failed to retrieve at this capture, and copying them from another page or deriving them from scores would be inference. The eight clubs are recorded with W-L-T only and excluded from the correlation sample, which is therefore n=24 and labelled as such. RESOLVED by a second read at 2026-11-18T04:21:00Z, same URL: the chunk came back and all 32 clubs now carry points for and against in data/derived/official_capture_2026-11-18.json, each row stamped with the read that produced it, and the official-only correlations moved from n=24 to n=32. The row stays in this register as the record of the failed read, because the value is still not what the root model uses and the check that refuses to publish a short read is the point.

rows.item: Game-day starters, inactive lists and snap shares for the Week 10 slate
rows.reason: The official game centre publishes a per-fixture Game Book PDF and the link was verified for one fixture, but the document was not opened at this capture. No starter, inactive or snap value is published from it; the depth and replacement columns therefore stay blank across the availability registers.

rows.item: Reconciliation of the root model outputs against the 2026-11-18 official read
rows.reason: The committed root analysis ends at the 2026-11-01 nflverse extract while the official pages were re-read 2026-11-18; the 17-day gap is reported rather than back-filled, so root model rows stay labelled third-party and are not upgraded to official by this capture.

rows.item: Opening and closing market prices for originated markets
rows.reason: Unchanged by this capture: 0 of 45 Line Desk market rows carry a market open or close, and the Price Store official-only file holds 0 rows. The residual column cannot exist until the price-data policy is decided (decision-readiness row RR-A9).

rows.item: One assertion in review-board/scripts/verify_all.py was inverted by the integration session
rows.reason: The check read 'the hub stays out of the shared root navigation', written while root navigation belonged to another session. Root navigation is now owned by this integration build, which links every hub directory that exists; the check was changed to assert the link exists instead. The hub's registers and pages were regenerated with its own documented generator. Logged here so the hub owner can review the edit.

rows.item: Vocabulary conflict between the two suggestion registers
rows.reason: pages/suggestions.html states that no suggestion has been authorised or implemented, while verify-hub/data/suggestions.json records 14 rows with dispositions ACCEPTED (3), PENDING (6) and NOT-ADOPTED (5), and suggestions/data/suggestions.json records 12 rows all dispositioned 'proposed'. The three registers use different vocabularies for the same object and have not been reconciled; nothing here adopts either reading. Discovery action: one disposition vocabulary, then re-state the page's claim to match it.

rows.item: Duplicate history table in review-board/pages/injuries.html (merged PR #133)
rows.reason: An append-only generator emitted the same table twice with different row counts (4 and 3), so the page's own count is self-contradictory. Recorded at the hub as review-board reconciliation finding FI-0 and left unfixed here: the file belongs to the injury-hub session, and the table's data columns are blank in both copies. The row count therefore stays blank in this register rather than picking one of the two copies.
